command:
cd /srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration
bash -s <<'MIGRATE_EOF'
set -eu
export LC_ALL=C
src_root=imported
dst_root=converted
report=conversion-collisions.log
report_tmp=$(mktemp .conversion-collisions.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -f -- "$report_tmp"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p -- "$dst_root"
converted_count=0
collision_count=0
error_count=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' src; do
  rel=${src#"$src_root"/}
  utf8_rel=$(printf '%s' "$rel" | iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8) || { printf 'ERROR invalid Latin-1 path: %q\n' "$src" >&2; error_count=$((error_count + 1)); continue; }
  dst=$dst_root/$utf8_rel
  parent=${dst%/*}
  mkdir -p -- "$parent"
  if [ -e "$dst" ] || [ -L "$dst" ]; then
    printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q action=preserved-existing-destination\n' "$src" "$dst" | tee -a "$report_tmp"
    collision_count=$((collision_count + 1))
    continue
  fi
  tmp=$(mktemp -p "$parent" .filename-migration.XXXXXX)
  if cp --preserve=mode,timestamps -- "$src" "$tmp" && ln -- "$tmp" "$dst"; then
    rm -f -- "$tmp"
    printf 'CONVERTED source=%q destination=%q\n' "$src" "$dst"
    converted_count=$((converted_count + 1))
  else
    rm -f -- "$tmp"
    if [ -e "$dst" ] || [ -L "$dst" ]; then
      printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q action=preserved-existing-destination\n' "$src" "$dst" | tee -a "$report_tmp"
      collision_count=$((collision_count + 1))
    else
      printf 'ERROR copy-failed source=%q destination=%q\n' "$src" "$dst" >&2
      error_count=$((error_count + 1))
    fi
  fi
done < <(find "$src_root" -type f -print0 | sort -z)
mv -f -- "$report_tmp" "$report"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'SUMMARY converted=%d collisions=%d errors=%d report=%q\n' "$converted_count" "$collision_count" "$error_count" "$report"
[ "$error_count" -eq 0 ]
MIGRATE_EOF
